runners.name: plebania
runners.label: planwat-plebania
runners.note: The home server: fast, but often switched off. Takes the lion's share whenever GitHub sees it online. Takes the WIG census (the Joomla tree Incapsula keeps from the VPS's datacenter address), at most once a day, so a new programme directory is crawled by whoever has WIG.

runners.name: oracle
runners.label: planwat-oracle
runners.note: The free Oracle VPS (deploy/runner/): slow and weak, but always up. Covers everything while plebania is off. Takes WIG whenever it is up: tested from both runners on 2026-10-26 (two passes each, 33/33 groups, identical calendars), so the fast machine's share stays on the faculties only it gets through.
